# WatchlistKit

> Format your IDX (Indonesia Stock Exchange) watchlist in seconds. Paste tickers in any format and export to TradingView, plain text, or newline-separated lists.

WatchlistKit is a free, browser-based tool by @alfindigital for cleaning and formatting Indonesian stock tickers. It automatically prefixes tickers with `IDX:`, deduplicates them, and outputs them in formats compatible with TradingView watchlists and other tools. Watchlists can be saved locally, merged, compared, shared by URL, and exported as `.txt` or PNG.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Paste tickers, format them for TradingView, save and manage watchlists.
- [Import to TradingView guide](/guides/import-to-tradingview): Step-by-step tutorial for bulk-importing IDX watchlists into TradingView.
